title: AI 'coffin/war' video tied to VOKS2025 anti-Ukraine consultation
what: In the final days of the VOKS2025 mail-in consultation on Ukraine's EU accession (ran to 20 June 2025), an AI-generated clip showing Hungarian soldiers in coffins/caskets and bloodied troops was advertised on Facebook and aired on state TV, paired with Orbán's warning that Hungarian children could 'come home in a coffin'. Part of Fidesz/government's apocalyptic anti-Ukraine framing.

title: Nemzeti Ellenállás Mozgalom (NEM) anti-Magyar AI-video blitz launches
what: The Megafon-adjacent 'National Resistance Movement' (NEM) launched a paid anti-Péter-Magyar ad blitz — beginning with a late-June/July 2025 campaign depicting Magyar as a 'Hungarian Zelensky' — that scaled into a massive, largely unlabelled AI-generated video operation (bathtub-on-the-Tisza clip, straitjacket, Minecraft, talking-animal videos). Over three months its ads ran 650+ million times on Facebook/YouTube for ~643 million forint.

title: AI 'vox pop' fake interview aired on Hungarian state/public media (M1)
what: A September 2025 public-service-media news segment on alleged Tisza-party tax increases featured a fabricated 'vox pop': per Telex, 'a non-existent reporter interviewing a non-existent person in a non-existent place' — AI-generated fake reporter and interviewee presented as a real street interview, aired without AI disclosure.

title: CopyCop uses self-hosted Llama-3 to mass-produce influence content (not Hungary-specific)
what: Recorded Future's Insikt Group reported (Sept 2025) that the Russia-linked CopyCop network (John Mark Dougan, GRU-tied) uses self-hosted, uncensored Meta Llama-3 models to plagiarise, translate and rewrite content at scale, spinning up 300+ fake news sites in 2025 targeting the US, France, Canada and others. Generative-AI tooling for content production; not Hungary-focused, included as tooling context.

title: 'Weber-on-a-leash' AI image of Magyar posted across Fidesz county papers
what: An AI-generated image depicting opposition leader Péter Magyar as a collared dog on a leash held by EPP leader Manfred Weber (with Orbán leading a flag-waving crowd) appeared simultaneously on the Facebook pages of Fidesz-controlled county newspapers on/around 21 October 2025. Unlabelled; Magyar condemned it as a humiliating fabrication.

title: Talking points: When chatbots surface Russian state media (ISD)
what: ISD tested 300 responses across ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok and DeepSeek: 18% cited Russian state-attributed sources overall - rising with prompt hostility (11% neutral, 18% biased, 24% malicious). ChatGPT cited Russian sources most; Grok frequently linked pro-Russian influencers amplifying RT; DeepSeek produced the densest single-query clusters; Gemini surfaced the least and showed safety warnings. Notably only two Pravda-network links appeared - lower than earlier studies - pointing to RT/influencer laundering as the live retrieval vector.
actor: Russian state media (RT) and amplifier network

title: Balázs Orbán pension deepfake of Magyar → criminal complaint
what: Fidesz political/campaign director Balázs Orbán posted a ~38-second AI-generated video on Facebook (28 Oct 2025) showing Magyar's fabricated likeness and voice saying pensions were too generous and some should be taxed — statements he never made. Magyar called it 'an open act of electoral fraud' and announced a criminal complaint against Balázs Orbán (29 Oct 2025).

title: AI 'robocall' video of Magyar → Meta Oversight Board case
what: On 4 Nov 2025 a Hungary-politics Facebook page posted an 8-second photorealistic AI-generated video of Péter Magyar expressing exaggerated frustration about campaign robocalling; the voice does not match Magyar's real voice. 209 users reported it (4–24 Nov); Meta kept it up with no AI label, and the Oversight Board took the case for review.

title: von der Leyen 'red phone' deepfake posted by Orbán
what: Around 6 Feb 2026 PM Viktor Orbán posted an AI/deepfake video on Facebook showing Ursula von der Leyen speaking Hungarian and phoning Péter Magyar on a red landline to 'give orders' about funding Ukraine. Openly AI (satirical framing), viewed 1.5M+ times. The European Commission publicly criticised the misleading use of AI and urged fair communication.

title: Fidesz 'CSALÁDUNK' AI war/execution video (peer-reviewed analysis)
what: On 19 Feb 2026 Fidesz's official Facebook page posted a ~30-second AI-generated black-and-white cinematic video depicting a fictional wartime family — a girl searching for her father, the mother crying, the father shot at close range while kneeling in mud — ending on the word 'CSALÁDUNK' ('Our Family') and the message that Brussels could make this reality, 'Fidesz is the safe choice.' Post introduced it as an AI-generated work.

title: NewsGuard Quarterly AI False Claim Monitor - January 2026 (the ~28% figure)
what: NewsGuard tested 11 leading chatbots (ChatGPT-5.2, You.com, Grok, Pi, Claude, Le Chat, Copilot, Meta AI, Gemini, Perplexity, DeepSeek) on 10 provably false claims in the news during Jan 2026. Headline: the tools repeated false claims 'more than 28%' of the time on controversial topics. Documented Russian-origin narratives among the failures (e.g. organ trafficking in Ukraine, Zelensky amassing a fortune). This is the quarterly the brief references.

title: 17 high-reach AI-persona TikTok channels (EDMO/Lakmusz)
what: EDMO and Lakmusz identified 17 high-reach TikTok channels launched in March 2026 using AI-generated personas (a young woman, an elderly professor, a soccer fan, talking animals) to push coordinated pro-government/anti-Tisza messages (e.g. Magyar will drag Hungary into war/mobilisation). Part of a larger cluster — 22 accounts created in two days; ~63 TikTok accounts and 17 Facebook pages overall; some clips exceeded 10M views.

title: AI 'cash van' images of seized Ukrainian cash-in-transit guards
what: After Hungary's ~5–6 Mar 2026 seizure of Oschadbank cash-in-transit vehicles en route Austria→Ukraine, AI-generated images exaggerating the haul (wrong uniforms/vehicles) circulated widely to smear Ukrainians. The Fidesz tabloid Ripost published them; posts drew ~48,000 reactions (vs its usual 10–200), ~99% from bots with Romanian/Moldovan names reused from Moldova influence ops.

title: Matryoshka (Kremlin/GRU) activates against Hungary's election with AI content
what: The Russian Matryoshka/'Overload' network activated around 13 Mar 2026, flooding platforms with fabricated videos/images impersonating trusted outlets (Deutsche Welle, Euronews, Kyiv Independent, United24) — including AI-generated 'truth serum' clips and false claims of 1,000+ assaults by Ukrainian refugees — to portray Orbán as a peacemaker/victim and inflame Hungarian-Ukrainian tensions before the vote.

title: 34-account AI-video TikTok network boosting Orbán (NewsGuard)
what: NewsGuard identified 34 covert TikTok accounts (22 created within two days, Jan 2026) posting hundreds of AI-generated videos to boost Orbán and discredit Magyar/Tisza: AI news anchors ('BrüsszelÜzem'), fake celebrities ('Hunywood' Depp/DiCaprio/Jake Paul), a fictional expert 'Dr. Zoltán Ferenczi', and animated characters. ~10M total views. TikTok confirmed to NewsGuard on 18 Mar 2026 it was a covert influence operation.

title: Post-vote AI image of Orban with Putin/Erdogan/Vucic over the Serbia gas-pipeline narrative
what: EDMO's fact-checking network documented that, after the 12 Apr vote, pro-Russian disinformation targeted newly elected PM Peter Magyar, and that an AI-generated image circulated showing (by-then ex-PM) Orban with Putin, Erdogan and Vucic supposedly striking a deal to 'protect' a shared gas pipeline — tied to a false claim that explosives near a Serbian pipeline were Ukrainian sabotage. Other post-vote false claims: Magyar's ex-wife Judit Varga 'published a book' accusing him of child abuse (one of the four widest-circulating EU falsehoods in April), that he won due to 'Jewish faith', 'woke' concessions for EU funds, and would revoke Ukrainians' work permits.

source.publisher: EDMO (Monthly fact-checking brief no. 59, read from PDF)

title: Pravda network still publishing at industrial scale in 2026 (NewsGuard / CheckFirst tracking)
what: Evidence the machine-generation continues NOW, not historically: the Pravda/Portal Kombat network published ~6.3 million articles in 2025 (repeating ~115 false claims), up from ~3.6M in 2024, and stood at ~370 websites with 286 active as of April 2026. CheckFirst's live Pravda Dashboard ingests the corpus and auto-updates hourly (project running 'April 2025 -' open-ended), and CheckFirst has piped the dataset into Filigran's OpenCTI for threat-intel use. The operation reportedly still emits a new article every few seconds.

title: DFRLab: Pravda-network content已 in AI training data ('LLM grooming') — mechanism behind the live Hungarian mirror
what: DFRLab ('Pravda in the pipeline', 8 Apr 2026) found state-adjacent propaganda already embedded in AI training pipelines: ~40,000 English-language Pravda-network articles present in Common Crawl by Nov 2025, and RT biolab disinformation reproducible 'almost verbatim' from Llama 3.1 405B Base via text-completion. Documents the ongoing AI-poisoning mechanism that makes the still-live Hungarian Pravda mirror strategically relevant beyond direct readership.

title: Storm-1516: Russia's AI-deepfake / synthetic-witness operation active through 2026
what: Storm-1516 (overlapping Matryoshka/Operation Overload) continues to mass-produce AI-generated deepfake videos, fabricated 'witnesses' and 100+ AI-spun fake news sites impersonating outlets, targeting European leaders and Ukraine. Bloomberg's April 2026 investigation documents the video operation's scale and the 'liar's dividend' goal; the operation persisted post-election - e.g. an August 7, 2026 push against German Chancellor Merz using a stolen Deutsche Welle logo. This is the Russian AI-PERSONA/deepfake track running in parallel to the LLM-grooming/text track.

title: Anthropic's Claude leaning more on Russian and Iranian propaganda sources (NewsGuard)
what: NewsGuard found Claude repeated pro-Kremlin falsehoods 15% of the time to typical user prompts - a sharp rise from 4% across the prior year of audits (Mar 2025-Feb 2026). Claude cited RT and three Pravda-network editions (France, Finland, Slovakia). On pro-Iran prompts it gave false info in 4/20 answers (20%), citing state-controlled Tehran Times - sources it had 'never cited' before. Tested narratives included the fabricated '450 Ukrainians die monthly crossing the Tisza river' claim.

title: Meta Oversight Board DISCONTINUED (did not decide) the Magyar AI-video case
what: The Oversight Board case on the ~8-second AI-generated video of Peter Magyar (posted Nov 2025, showing him ranting about robocalls; Meta had left it up) was closed on 12 May 2026 WITHOUT a merits ruling. The Board states the case 'became unavailable for review... as a result of user action' — the original poster deleted the video after the Board had selected the case (23 Apr 2026) and begun deliberations. Public comments (e.g. WITNESS, EFCSN, submitted early May 2026) will be carried to future AI cases. No precedent or binding recommendation was issued.

title: EDMO: AI-generated disinformation share fell in April 2026, partly attributed to Sora shutdown
what: EDMO Brief no. 59 (published 15 May 2026, covering April 2026) reports the share of disinformation created or manipulated with AI DROPPED six percentage points versus March, back to Nov-2025 levels: 236 of 1,644 fact-checks (14%) concerned AI content. EDMO attributes the fall partly to a lack of major crises and to 'the discontinuation of OpenAI's Sora' video app. Named April AI cases were mostly non-Hungarian (AI moon-landing/Artemis-II denial images; AI depictions of Italy's Meloni; US-Israel-Iran war imagery), indicating AI-disinfo intensity eased and shifted away from Hungary immediately after the election.

title: Global Voices post-mortem: Fidesz AI-generated campaigning backfired; Russian disinfo failed to spread
what: Retrospective analysis (15 May 2026) concluding Fidesz's heavy AI-generated content (e.g. cheap AI clips of Magyar on a leash led by Weber, von der Leyen 'calling' Magyar) was deployed 'too early and in too cheap a way' and was rejected even by pro-government users; Russian disinformation 'did not really spread widely' thanks to pre-bunking by researchers/independent media, and leaked Lavrov-Szijjarto / Putin-Orban recordings rebounded against Fidesz. Frames the campaign's AI manipulation as largely ineffective.

title: CEDMO/GLOBSEC Forum 2026 panel on the Pravda network's continuing Central-Europe operations
what: At the GLOBSEC Forum 2026 (Prague, 23 May 2026; CEDMO writeup 28 May 2026), CEDMO researcher Jakub Kubs presented mapping of the Pravda network's sources, reach and operational logic and how such sites exploit algorithmic amplification across Central Europe, the Black Sea region and Western Europe. Confirms sustained post-election research attention to the Pravda ecosystem (which includes the live Hungarian mirror), though this specific writeup does not name AI/LLM techniques or Hungary explicitly.

title: Concerns over Russian propaganda spread by Mistral's Le Chat (Institute of the Estonian Language / NewsGuard, via Euronews)
what: The Institute of the Estonian Language evaluated 60 AI models across 14 Russian-propaganda themes; all four Mistral versions scored below 40% at detecting Kremlin talking points, with at least 12 answers referencing sanctioned sources like RT/Sputnik. Alongside, NewsGuard's April 2026 analysis found Mistral's Le Chat repeated Russian falsehoods 50% of the time in English and 56.6% in French, with the Pravda network/Portal Kombat identified as the likely source-poisoning culprit. Mistral did not respond.

source.publisher: Euronews (citing Institute of the Estonian Language and NewsGuard)

title: AI chatbots citing Russian propaganda from an EU-sanctioned outlet (Demos, via Euronews)
what: UK think tank Demos tested five mainstream LLMs (Grok, GPT-4.1 Mini, Claude, Gemini, Mistral Small 3.2) on 50 narratives drawn from 10 articles by r-FBI (Foundation to Battle Injustice), a US/EU-sanctioned outlet founded by the late Wagner chief Prigozhin, in English/German/French. Result: 16.6% of responses engaged with r-FBI material in ways serving propaganda interests, 30.9% addressed the topic without flagging the sanctioned source, and only 52% debunked. GPT-4.1 Mini cited r-FBI to support a false 'Ukraine makes meat products from soldiers' corpses' claim; Mistral Small 3.2 backed crypto-mining allegations against Ukrainian officials. Demos warns the emerging 'generative engine optimization' (GEO) industry is exploitable for state information warfare.

title: Storm-1516 still AI-active in Europe post-election: fabricated Merz 'resignation' report (Aug 2026)
what: Germany's security services told AFP the creator of a fabricated report claiming Chancellor Friedrich Merz would resign was 'probably Storm-1516' (the GRU-linked Russian network, aka CopyCop, that heavily targeted Hungary's campaign). The fake impersonated Deutsche Welle and Handelsblatt branding to pass invented 'leaked documents' as real news; both outlets and Merz's office issued immediate denials (7-8 Aug 2026). Demonstrates the same network that ran AI fake-news/impersonation ops against Hungary remains operational and AI-driven in Europe after the Hungarian vote — but retargeted to Germany/France, not Hungary.

source.publisher: The Local / AFP (also RTE, German fact-checker GADMO)

title: Pravda network Hungarian mirror (hungary.news-pravda.com) still live, pushing anti-Magyar/pro-Kremlin narratives
what: The Hungarian-language mirror of Russia's Pravda/'news-pravda' network is confirmed live and actively publishing, evidenced by this project's own server-side capture and CheckFirst's hourly dataset rather than by linking the mirror. Fresh articles dated 10-11 Aug 2026 attack EU policy and target new PM Peter Magyar (e.g. framing his stance on EU energy policy and the EUR 90bn EU loan to Ukraine). The Pravda network is not a bespoke-deepfake operation but a high-volume aggregation/laundering ecosystem whose documented strategic purpose is 'LLM grooming' — flooding the open web so its narratives are ingested into AI model training data and surfaced by chatbots.

source.publisher: CheckFirst — Pravda Network Data Collection (hourly); network mapped by DFRLab & GLOBSEC
